core_capabilities: Create, rename, close, and reopen financial accounts and maintain their transaction registers by adding, importing, editing, categorizing, and reconciling transactions.
Allocate money to envelope categories, monitor budgeted, spent, and remaining balances, and create, rename, organize, hide, or delete categories and category groups.
Create and maintain recurring schedules that track upcoming, due, completed, or missed financial transactions.
Analyze finances through built-in reports and configurable report dashboards.
secondary_capabilities: Maintain payees, automatic transaction rules, and user-defined tags used to organize financial records.
Move financial data in or out by importing transaction files, exporting the currently queried transactions as CSV, and exporting a budget archive.
Manage the full budget-file lifecycle by creating, opening or downloading, switching, importing, duplicating, and deleting local or synced budget files.
Search transaction registers, compose field-based filters, and save, update, reload, rename, clear, or delete reusable filters.
Enable end-to-end encryption for synchronized budget data or replace its encryption key.
Customize display and locale preferences, including theme, language, number and date formats, decimal visibility, and the first day of the week.
Switch a budget between envelope budgeting and tracking budgeting modes.
